desc:
🐻 Welcome to Bubu & Dudu Obby! [2 Player Obby] 🐼

🌸 A CUTE ADVENTURE FOR YOU AND YOUR FRIENDS! 🌸

🐼 Play as Bubu & Dudu, an adorable bear duo!
🤝 Team up with a friend and tackle obstacles together!
🔗 Stay connected—every jump takes teamwork!
🌈 Explore colorful worlds, cherry blossoms, and exciting challenges!
🪙 Earn coins and unlock cute skins and pets!
🏁 Help each other reach the finish!

👍 Like the game and join our group if you love Bubu & Dudu!

🏆 How far can you and your bestie make it?
